summary: Refine the existing MeghRaj Exports website visual design (no structural/layout changes) to a soft luxury theme using the provided navy/warm/off-white/blue tint/gold palette, adding subtle glassmorphism to all cards and improving typography, spacing, navigation, hero, and modal styling.
architectural_notes: Do not change site structure/layout; apply styling-only updates (CSS/theme) while preserving existing components and markup.

existing_features.title: Update the global theme tokens and base styles to match the provided soft-luxury palette and reduce the current overly-dark/flat look, while avoiding pure white as the dominant background. Apply: Primary Navy #0E1A2B, Warm Background #F4F1EA, Light Bluish Section Tint #EEF2F7, Accent Gold #C5A24D, Primary Text #1F2A3A, Muted Text #5C677D. Ensure body/background defaults, card/popover colors, border/input colors, and text colors produce strong readability (no white-on-white).

Implement a consistent glassmorphism card style and apply it to all cards: product cards, subcategory cards, feature cards, and modal content container. Glass style must use: background rgba(255,255,255,0.65), backdrop blur 12px, border-radius 12px, 1px border rgba(197,162,77,0.25), and a soft subtle shadow (no heavy shadows, no glow, no strong gradients).

Fix typography, spacing, and contrast site-wide to improve readability while preserving existing structure: increase body text line-height where needed, ensure headings feel elegant/strong, remove any cases of white text on near-white backgrounds, and increase section padding to create breathing space without changing layout composition.

Restrict Accent Gold usage to premium highlights only: button backgrounds, thin divider lines, card hover borders, and active navigation underline. Remove/avoid other decorative gold usage so it remains minimal and premium.

Refine the navigation/header styling to a soft translucent white look with blur and dark navy text (not white), including a thin gold underline for the active link. Remove heavy fills/strong backgrounds for both desktop and mobile navigation states while keeping the same navigation structure and behavior.

Refine the Home page hero section styling: keep the hero image strong, add a subtle overlay gradient behind the text area only (not across the entire hero), and ensure hero text remains highly readable with the new palette (avoid overly dark full-screen overlays).

Refine modal styling to match the soft luxury theme: modal content container uses an off-white surface with slight blur, a thin gold border, elegant spacing, and the same glassmorphism card treatment; keep the existing modal structure and interactions (ESC, click outside, scroll lock).

Update the footer styling to match the soft luxury theme and readability rules: avoid dark-only footer treatment with white headings on a light background, ensure footer headings and links use the correct foreground/muted colors, and keep gold accents minimal (links/dividers only).

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement soft luxury visual styling for MeghRaj Exports site without changing structure (color system, glassmorphism cards, typography/contrast, spacing, nav/hero/modal refinements, restrained gold accents).
